These generated packages come from [protocol #87](https://github.com/tumpel/protocol/pull/87), source commit `6877a3dfc3cd8426853412b6eeadb8ba5ddb0e54` on `feat/53-turn-budget`.

Build them in that checkout with `npm run generate` and `npm run pack`. The package lock records their integrity hashes.

Replace the local tarballs with the protocol release URLs after that PR merges and publishes its release. Supervisor enforcement ships separately against the same protocol branch.
